correction: A CI step that installs an unversioned distribution package for a tool with a minimum version checks that minimum in the step itself, because the runner image decides the version and a test that fails later hides the cause.
evidence: frostyard/updex#549 cross-review at 329f979: the step printed dump.erofs -V but did not fail below 1.8.5 (Ubuntu 24.04 ships 1.7.1)
